content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the software enabling LTR (Latency Tolerance Reporting) in an endpoint without verifying that the Root Complex and all intermediate switches supported LTR, as mandated by the PCIe Base Specification. This oversight led to Unsupported Request errors during ASPM (Active State Power Management) enablement, which were reported through AER (Advanced Error Reporting). The patch corrects this by ensuring that LTR is only enabled if it is supported in the path, thus preventing the error.
